bullets.text: Spotify's Book Feature Launches - **Spotify** enables users to buy physical books directly through its app, supporting local bookstores.
Motorola Razr Fold Pricing Revealed - The **Motorola Razr Fold** is available for pre-order in the UK at £1,800.
Motorola Razr Fold Release Date Set - Pre-orders for the **Razr Fold** will ship on May 6 in the UK and Europe.
Apple Execs Discuss MacBook Neo - **Apple** executives highlight the success of the MacBook Neo in a recent interview.
Apple Pulls Malicious Apps - **Apple** removes fake apps from the App Store after reports of stolen user funds.
Pioneer Introduces Dolby Atmos CarPlay - **Pioneer** launches the first aftermarket receiver with Dolby Atmos for existing vehicles.
DeepL Expands Voice Translation - **DeepL** launches a voice-to-voice translation suite for meetings and conversations.
X-energy Files for IPO - **X-energy**, backed by **Amazon**, aims to raise up to $800 million in its IPO.
YouTube Lets Users Disable Shorts - **YouTube** introduces a feature allowing users to turn off Shorts entirely.
Ford's EV Chief Doug Field Exits - **Ford** announces the departure of Doug Field, its EV and tech chief.
